code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, CRP, INR, and mild monocytosis and basophilia. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and hypoxemic respiratory failure. The pattern is compatible with severe infection or inflammatory process (e.g., severe COVID-19 or sepsis). Immediate clinical correlation and urgent management are recommended.
